title: Model and data for "Market-driven co-sizing of a hybrid power–hydrogen virtual power plant for energy and frequency reserve markets"
description:
This record freezes the optimisation model and the case-study data used in the study “Market-driven co-sizing of a hybrid power–hydrogen virtual power plant for energy and frequency reserve markets” (Alvarez, Gutierrez-Guerra, and Ramos). It is the tagged release v1.0.1-h2vppfcr, kept so that every result in the paper can be reproduced from a fixed model version.

The model. el1xr_opt is an open-source mixed-integer linear optimization model, built in Pyomo, that co-optimizes the sizing (investment) and the operation of hybrid renewable energy systems coupling electricity and hydrogen. It includes unit commitment, storage dynamics, a pressure-resolved hydrogen network with compression, and frequency containment reserve (FCR) provision with endurance and response-speed constraints. It extends the openTEPES modelling framework and ships automatic solver setup. Development continues at github.com/EL1XR-dev/el1xr_opt; this record is a snapshot, not the current version.

The data. Under data/H2VPPFCR/: the 2025 SE3 market series (day-ahead, FCR-N and FCR-D capacity prices, activation duties), the ERA5 site wind, the hydrogen-demand profiles, the techno-economic parameters, the case builder, and the experiment configurations. Every case in the paper regenerates from these inputs against this model version.
